capabilities: Render diagrams from .puml, .mermaid, .mmd files and fenced plantuml/mermaid code blocks
Switch between diagram view and editable source with line numbers
Zoom, drag-to-pan, and auto-fit diagrams in a fullscreen overlay or viewer
Export diagrams as PNG, SVG, or ASCII art text
Configure render servers (PlantUML, Kroki, or a local server)
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not PlantUML-only or view-only: it also renders Mermaid and offers source editing with line numbers.
extras: The README discloses that diagram source is sent over the network to the configured render server; no accounts, payments, telemetry, or ads are involved. No accounts or payments are required.
intentEvidence: A plugin for Obsidian that renders PlantUML/Mermaid from diagram files and from markdown code blocks.
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid in notes, so PlantUML diagrams and standalone .puml files have no built-in viewer or export path.

relations.evidence: renders PlantUML/Mermaid from diagram files and from markdown code blocks

requires.name: a render server (PlantUML server, Kroki, or a local server)

summary: Renders PlantUML and Mermaid diagrams from standalone diagram files and markdown code blocks, with zoom, pan, and PNG/SVG/ASCII export.
